commit_object_verification_limit: Commit SHA identifiers and bindings are checked from the saved refetched API objects. Raw commit object bytes are not supplied and commit SHA-1 reserialization is not attempted. GitHub reports all six commits unsigned; no cryptographic author authentication or signature certification is claimed.
commit_to_tree_mapping_basis: The saved refetched GitHub /git/commits responses directly supply each commit tree SHA and parent SHA list. These are matched to the recursive tree snapshots and the exact six-commit chain. This replaces the earlier audit reliance on supplied publication ordering alone.

final_CI_delta.scope_limit: This is a tree/content comparison. It does not itself execute CI or establish a native qualification result.

git_object_method: Git SHA-1 of type + space + decimal byte length + NUL + object bytes. Authored JSON strings are encoded as UTF-8 without newline or content rewriting. Recursive tree snapshots are reconstructed as canonical tree objects, including Git directory sort and mode representation. Canonical JSON SHA-256 fields identify the normalized saved API response objects, not original HTTP wire bytes.

input.declared_scope: Content held from actual GitHub publication, with refetched commit objects and recursive trees for exact ancestry/tree/blob verification.

limitations: The input contains saved refetched GitHub commit/tree responses and authored publication contents supplied by the parent. This audit makes no new network request and does not independently refetch GitHub.

Commit-to-tree bindings and the parent chain are verified from the refetched commit response objects. Raw commit bytes are absent, so commit SHA-1 reserialization is not performed. All six responses report unsigned commits; there is no cryptographic authorship claim.
Only the six named publication commits are covered. Other branches, tags, pull-request refs, deleted refs, unreachable objects and later commits are not asserted to be covered.
The local repository has no HEAD and zero reachable commits. No local-history scan success is implied.

Secret detection uses the six existing regular-expression rules, with the existing test_registry.py negative-fixture exception preserved. It is not entropy analysis, hosted secret validation or a guarantee that every possible secret is absent.
The scanner skips binary, non-UTF-8 and oversized contents by design; any such skips are reported explicitly rather than treated as a clean scan.
Dependency vulnerabilities, legal license clearance and runtime/native qualification are outside this audit scope.

local_git_history_observation.interpretation: No local HEAD and zero reachable local commits; this report audits supplied hosted commit/tree responses and publication contents, not local Git history.

scope: Independent bounded audit of six successful publication snapshots from initial commit through final CI capture. No raw source contents, raw commit messages or matched secret values are copied into this report.

reviewed_fixture_exceptions.reason: Existing reviewed negative URL-validation fixture exception in inspect_text; no matched value is included.
